name: Ortur Laser Master H10 20W
tagline: 20W Ortur's enclosed-style H-series: faster frame, tighter integration than LM3
tldr: Ortur Laser Master H10 20W is the 20W SKU on the Ortur ortur laser master h10 line. The H10 is Ortur's step up from the open-frame LM3 line: a more integrated chassis with up to 20W diode power and higher advertised traverse speeds. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Everyday engraving plus reliable light cutting on wood, leather, and dark acrylic

priceRange.note: Official Ortur store, Oct 2026: $550 to $730 depending on listing and bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Free air pump with this module on Ortur's store
Ortur demonstrates 8 mm plywood and 8 mm black acrylic cut in one pass
Module rated by Ortur for more than 10,000 hours
cons: Larger 0.1 × 0.12 mm focal spot (Ortur figure): fine photos look softer than with the lower-power module
Fills at ~22–49 mm/s in our tests: a 10 × 10 cm photo still takes ~18–28 min
Real 8 mm cuts need slow speeds, a clean lens and a working air pump
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W SKU on Ortur Laser Master H10. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Use air assist for cuts, lower scan speed for photo engraving. Multiple passes at moderate speed beat one aggressive pass. Check the flagship tier’s cut benchmark if you quote production times to customers.

editorialDepth.advantages: Ortur Laser Master H10 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU: clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame: glasses and exhaust required. Ortur offers no 40W module for the H10: if cutting takes over, look at its 40W machines (LM3, F10, H20). Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.

faq.question: What does the H10 20W cut in one pass?
faq.answer: Ortur's page shows one-pass demo cuts in 12 mm pine, 8 mm plywood and 8 mm black acrylic with the LU3-20B module; these are demos, not guaranteed maxima. In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 9–15 min, and basswood up to about 8 mm is realistic in passes.

faq.question: Does the H10 20W include air assist?
faq.answer: Yes, Ortur sells the 20W version with a free air pump. In October 2026 the basic set was $549.99–649.99 depending on the listing, $589.98–679.98 with the ORP1.0 raiser and $659.98–729.98 with the LEP1.0 bundle.

faq.question: H10 20W or 40W?
faq.answer: Ortur's H10 page lists only 10W and 20W modules, and its compatibility list does not include the separate LU3-40A 40W module. The 20W is the configuration Ortur officially supports on the H10; choose a 40W listing only if the seller confirms compatibility.

standoutFeatures.title: Air pump in the box
standoutFeatures.body: Ortur bundles a free air pump with the 20W H10, so clean cuts do not need an extra purchase.

standoutFeatures.title: 8 mm in one pass
standoutFeatures.body: Ortur demonstrates 8 mm plywood and 8 mm black acrylic cut in a single pass with the LU3-20B module.

standoutFeatures.title: Long module life
standoutFeatures.body: Ortur rates the LU3-20B module for more than 10,000 hours of use.
